paths._comment: relative to the project root (the folder that holds sts1/)

fight._comment: defaults for new_game / new_battle; encounter is any name in slaythespire.MonsterEncounter

mcts._comment: built-in MCTS (teacher and baseline): simulations per decision

llm._comment: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1, https://api.deepseek.com/v1, https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1, http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama). model "random" = dry run, calls nothing. Empty base_url = run model locally with transformers (GPU), e.g. model "Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507" with adapter "runs/sft/final" (relative to the project root; "" = no LoRA). The key: api_key, or else the environment variable named in api_key_env. config.json is git-ignored; never put a key in config.example.json. extra_body: extra request fields for this provider, e.g. {"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}} stops DeepSeek-style models from thinking ~2000 tokens before every answer.

play._comment: what llm.py plays: mode "battle" = one fight, "game" = a whole run; games use seeds seed, seed+1, ...

collect._comment: collect.py: MCTS plays `games` fights of fight.encounter from seed_start; split train:val:test by seed (never by step)
